title: Chest Expander Resistance Bar
summary: A bar-and-band trainer for arm, chest and back exercises at home.
description:
A simple home trainer that combines a bar with resistance tubes. Pull, press and row to work your arms, chest, shoulders and back without needing a gym.

It's light, easy to store and quick to set up in a living room or bedroom. Start with gentle movements and build up gradually.
bullets: Bar and resistance tubes in one
Works arms, chest, shoulders and back

title: Fluffy Donut Pet Bed
summary: A round, fluffy bed with a raised rim for small dogs and cats to snuggle into.
description:
A soft donut-shaped bed with long, fluffy fibres and a raised rim. Pets can curl up in the middle and rest their heads on the edge, which many find especially cosy.

Available in several colours and sizes. Check the size options to pick the right one for your pet.

title: Car Door Cup & Bottle Holder
summary: An adjustable holder that clips into the car door to hold a drink, phone or sunglasses.
description:
Short on cup holders? This handy holder fits into the door panel and gives you an extra spot for a drink, bottle or can. It can also hold a phone, keys or sunglasses.

The holder can be angled to suit the space, and it's available in several colours.
bullets: Extra holder for drinks and cans
Fits into the car door panel
Also holds phones, keys and sunglasses

title: Double-Layer Cat Litter Mat
summary: A honeycomb mat that catches litter from your cat's paws before it spreads round the house.
description:
Place this mat in front of the litter tray and it catches the litter your cat carries out on its paws. The top layer has holes that let litter fall through, and a waterproof bottom layer holds it until you empty it.

To empty it, simply open the layers and tip the litter back into the tray or the bin. It comes in several sizes, with foldable versions available.
bullets: Two layers: holes on top, waterproof below

title: Splash-Reducing Floating Dog Bowl
summary: A water bowl with a floating disc that slows drinking and helps keep floors drier.
description:
Messy drinkers splash water everywhere. This bowl has a floating disc that sits on the water and lets your dog drink from the middle, which helps reduce splashes and dripping chins.

The wide base is designed to resist tipping, and it comes in several colours and twin packs.

title: Double-Sided Pet Grooming Comb
summary: A two-sided grooming comb for loose fur and tangles on dogs and cats.
description:
A two-sided grooming tool for regular brushing. One side helps loosen tangles, while the other gathers loose undercoat, so less fur ends up on your floors and furniture.

The handle is easy to grip, and the comb suits both long and short coats. Brush gently in the direction of the fur.
bullets: Two sides: tangles and loose fur

title: Treat-Dispensing Rubber Dog Ball
summary: A chewy rubber ball with a hollow centre for treats, to keep dogs busy.
description:
Fill the centre with small treats or kibble and your dog will work to get them out as the ball rolls. It's a fun way to keep them busy and engaged.

The rubber is textured for chewing, and the ball comes in several sizes. Pick a size larger than your dog's mouth can swallow and supervise play.
bullets: Hollow centre for treats or kibble

title: Magnetic Windscreen Frost Cover
summary: A cover that sits over your windscreen to keep off frost, snow and summer sun.
description:
Skip the scraping on cold mornings. Lay this cover over your windscreen overnight and the magnetic edges help hold it in place. In the morning, peel it off and shake away the frost or snow.

In summer it works as a sunshade too. Choose the size to suit your car.
bullets: Helps keep frost and snow off the windscreen
Magnetic edges help hold it in place

title: Long-Pile Round Cat Bed
summary: A deep, fluffy round bed with a non-slip base for cats and small dogs.
description:
A round bed with long, soft fibres for pets who love to burrow and curl up. The non-slip base helps it stay put on hard floors.

The cover can be washed when it needs a refresh. Several colours and sizes are available.

title: Double-Sided Microfibre Car Towel
summary: A two-sided microfibre cloth for washing, drying and polishing your car.
description:
A thick microfibre towel with a different texture on each side: one for washing and wiping, the other for drying and buffing.

Use it on paintwork, windows and the interior. It can go in the washing machine, and comes in several sizes and multipacks.
bullets: Two sides for washing and drying
Use on paint, glass and interiors

title: Fleece Stretch Sofa Cover
summary: A soft, stretchy fleece cover that refreshes a sofa and protects it from everyday wear.
description:
Give a tired sofa a new look, or protect a good one from pets and spills. This stretchy fleece cover pulls over the sofa and tucks in to fit snugly.

Choose your colour and your sofa size, from a single chair to larger sofas, with matching cushion covers available.
bullets: Sizes from armchair to larger sofas

title: Sewing Needle Threader Tool
summary: A small tool that makes threading a sewing needle quick and easy.
description:
Threading a needle can be fiddly, especially in poor light. This little threader does the tricky part for you: put the needle in, add the thread and pull it through.

It's small enough for any sewing box. Choose a single tool or a multipack.
bullets: Small enough for any sewing kit

title: Skipping Rope with Jump Counter
summary: An adjustable skipping rope with a counter in the handle that tracks your jumps.
description:
Skipping is a quick, easy workout that you can do almost anywhere. This rope has a counter built into the handle, so you can track your jumps and set yourself targets.

The length adjusts to your height, and the foam handles are comfortable to grip. It packs small for the gym or holiday.

title: Plush Car Wash Mitt
summary: A soft, deep-pile wash mitt that holds plenty of soapy water for washing paintwork.
description:
A comfortable wash mitt with a deep, soft pile that soaks up soapy water and spreads it across the paintwork. Slip it on your hand and work panel by panel, rinsing it often to keep grit off the paint.

It also works well on bikes and motorbikes. Choose a single mitt or a twin pack.
bullets: Soft, deep pile holds soapy water

title: No-Drill Corner Shelf
summary: A metal corner shelf that sticks to the wall, so you can add storage without drilling.
description:
Turn an empty corner into useful storage. This metal shelf fixes to the wall with adhesive pads, so there's no drilling and no damage to tiles, which makes it handy for rented homes.

Use it in the shower for bottles, or in the kitchen for jars and sponges. Options include extra adhesive pads.
bullets: Fixes with adhesive pads: no drilling

title: Two-Person Lightweight Camping Tent
summary: A double-layer tent for two with a separate inner tent and rain fly.
description:
A two-person tent for weekends away, festivals and hiking trips. It has a separate inner tent and outer rain fly, which helps with weather protection and airflow, and a tough groundsheet.

It's designed to be quick to pitch and packs down for carrying. Choose from several colours.
bullets: Separate inner tent and outer fly

title: Reusable Silicone Food Storage Bags
summary: Seal-top silicone bags for leftovers, snacks and fruit, in a choice of sizes.
description:
Swap single-use bags for reusable ones. These silicone bags seal at the top and are handy for leftovers, chopped fruit and veg, snacks and packed lunches.

They come in several sizes and colours, so you can colour-code your fridge and freezer. Wash and reuse them again and again.
bullets: For fridge, freezer and lunch boxes

title: Portable Rechargeable Blender Cup
summary: A USB-rechargeable blender bottle for smoothies and shakes at home or on the go.
description:
Blend a smoothie or shake wherever you are. Add your ingredients, press the button and the motor in the base blends them right in the cup you drink from.

It charges by USB, so there's no plug to find. Rinse it after each use and charge it ready for the next one. Choose your colour and size.
bullets: Blend and drink from the same cup
Compact for work, gym and travel

title: Adjustable Pet Car Seat Belt Lead
summary: A short adjustable tether that clips your dog's harness to the car seat belt buckle.
description:
Keep your dog settled in one place on car journeys. One end clicks into the seat belt buckle and the other clips to your dog's harness, so they can sit or lie down but not wander around the car.

The length adjusts to suit your dog and your car. Always use it with a harness, not a collar.
bullets: Clicks into the seat belt buckle

title: Light-Up LED Dog Collar
summary: An adjustable collar with built-in LED lights so your dog is easy to spot after dark.
description:
Make your dog easier to see on evening walks. This collar has LED lights along its length, with steady and flashing modes.

Choose a battery or USB-rechargeable version in a range of colours and sizes. Remove the small protective film from the switch before first use.
bullets: LED lights with steady and flashing modes

title: Seat & Back Chair Cushion Set
summary: A soft cushion with an attached backrest that makes dining and office chairs more comfortable.
description:
Make hard chairs more comfortable. This cushion combines a seat pad and a backrest in one piece, adding soft padding to dining chairs, office chairs and stools.

It's filled with springy fibre and comes in a range of soft colours. Check the options for sizes and multipacks.
bullets: Seat pad and backrest in one

title: Metal Hose Spray Gun for Car Washing
summary: A sturdy alloy spray gun that connects to your garden hose for washing the car and patio.
description:
A solid metal hose gun that gives you a focused spray for washing cars, rinsing patios and cleaning garden furniture.

The grip is comfortable and the nozzle adjusts the spray. Choose a single gun or a multipack.

title: Plush Round Pet Nest
summary: A soft, round pet nest with high sides, in sizes for cats and dogs.
description:
A comfy round nest with soft sides that pets can snuggle against. The plush lining makes it a warm spot for naps.

It comes in a wide range of colours and in sizes from small to large, so check the options to find the right fit.

title: Between-Seat Car Handbag Holder
summary: A net holder that fits between the front seats to hold a bag, so it doesn't slide around.
description:
Stop your handbag sliding into the footwell. This holder fits between the two front seats, keeping a bag, documents or a tablet within reach and in place.

Versions with extra pockets are available for phones and small items.
bullets: Keeps your bag in place and within reach

title: Reflective Tape for Bikes & Cars
summary: A roll of reflective tape for adding visibility to bikes, helmets, cars and kit.
description:
A roll of bright reflective tape that catches headlights after dark. Cut it to size and stick it to bikes, wheel rims, trailers, bins or outdoor kit.

Several colours and patterns are available. Check local rules before adding markings to a vehicle.
bullets: For bikes, trailers and outdoor kit

title: Tilted Ceramic Pet Bowl
summary: A heavy ceramic bowl with a slanted top that makes it easier for cats and small dogs to eat.
description:
A stylish ceramic bowl with a tilted top that brings the food towards your pet, making it easier to reach the last bites.

Ceramic is heavy enough to stay put while they eat and easy to wash. Choose from several colours or a set.

title: Car Underbody Cleaning Wand
summary: A long wand and brush for washing under the car and in wheel arches.
description:
Mud, salt and grime collect under the car and in the wheel arches. This long wand connects to your hose so you can reach right underneath without lying on the ground.

Options include extension rods and a washing brush.

title: Inflatable Back-Seat Car Bed
summary: An inflatable mattress that fits across the back seat for road trips and camping.
description:
Turn the back seat into a place to rest on long road trips, at festivals or when camping. The mattress fits across the rear seats and has a soft flocked top.

It folds up small when deflated and comes in several colours. Only use it when parked.

title: Faux Leather Pet Carrier Bag
summary: A smart, structured shoulder bag for carrying small dogs and cats.
description:
A stylish carrier for small pets, with a structured shape that keeps its form and soft faux leather that wipes clean.

It's handy for vet visits, travel and trips out. Choose a colour and size, and check your pet's measurements before ordering.

title: Natural Wooden Serving Bowl
summary: A light, natural wooden bowl with visible grain, for fruit, salad, snacks or display.
description:
A simple, natural wooden bowl that brings warmth to the table. The visible grain means every bowl looks slightly different.

Use the small sizes for dips, nuts and sauces, and the larger ones for fruit or salad. Wipe clean or hand-wash, and dry straight away.
bullets: Sizes from dip bowl to fruit bowl

title: Window Cat Hammock
summary: A hammock that attaches to a window with suction cups, giving your cat a sunny lookout.
description:
Cats love a high spot with a view. This hammock attaches to a clean, smooth window with strong suction cups and gives your cat a comfy place to watch the world go by.

Press the suction cups on firmly and check them regularly. Several colours are available.
bullets: Attaches to windows with suction cups
Fabric bed on a supportive frame

title: Cute Deer Silicone Night Light
summary: A soft silicone deer or rabbit lamp that glows gently and charges by USB.
description:
A charming soft lamp shaped like a deer or rabbit. Tap it to switch on a warm, gentle glow, which is just right for a bedside table or a reading nook.

It charges by USB, so you can move it from room to room without a cable.

title: Black Walnut Chopping & Serving Board
summary: A thick walnut board for chopping, carving or serving cheese and charcuterie.
description:
A solid walnut board that's as good for serving as it is for prep. It's double-sided, so you can chop on one side and keep the other looking smart for the table.

Choose rectangular or round. Hand-wash, dry straight away and oil now and then to keep the wood looking good.

title: Self-Cleaning Pet Slicker Brush
summary: A round-handled grooming brush that releases the collected fur at the press of a button.
description:
Brushing helps keep coats tidy and catches loose fur before it lands on your sofa. Brush as normal, then press the button to release the fur from the pins in one go.

The round handle is comfortable to hold, and it suits cats and dogs.

title: Rose LED String Lights
summary: Fairy lights with little rose-shaped bulbs, powered by batteries or USB.
description:
Fairy lights with a romantic twist: each bulb sits in a little rose. Drape them over a headboard, mirror or shelf, or use them for parties.

Choose your colour, length and a battery or USB version. Batteries aren't included.

title: Car Snow & Frost Cover Set
summary: Covers for the windscreen, rear window and mirrors, to save scraping on frosty mornings.
description:
Choose from front, rear and mirror covers, or get the set. Fit them the night before, and in the morning you simply lift them off with the snow and frost.

Magnetic strips and door flaps help keep them in place. Check the options for what's included.
bullets: Magnetic strips help hold them in place

title: Cat Grooming & Bath Bag
summary: A mesh bag that keeps cats calm and contained for bathing, nail trimming or giving medicine.
description:
Bath time and nail trims are easier when your cat feels secure. This mesh bag wraps around your cat, with zips that let you reach one paw at a time.

The mesh lets water through for bathing, and the adjustable fit suits most cats.

title: Nordic Ceramic Vase
summary: A minimalist ceramic vase in soft tones, for dried flowers, stems or on its own.
description:
A simple, Scandinavian-style ceramic vase in a matt finish. It looks great with dried grasses and single stems, or just on its own on a shelf.

There are several shapes to choose from, so you can group a few together.

title: Flat Mop & Wringing Bucket
summary: A flat microfibre mop with a squeeze bucket that washes and wrings the pad for you.
description:
Clean floors without touching dirty water. Slide the mop through one side of the bucket to wash it and the other to squeeze it dry.

The flat head turns easily to reach corners and under furniture. Choose how many spare microfibre pads you want.
bullets: Washes and wrings without touching the pad
Choose the number of spare pads

title: Stainless Steel Pet Bowl
summary: A classic steel bowl with a non-slip base for food or water.
description:
A simple, sturdy bowl for everyday feeding. Stainless steel is easy to wash, and the non-slip base helps stop it from sliding across the floor.

It comes in a range of sizes from cats to large dogs, singly or in pairs.
bullets: Sizes from cats to large dogs

title: Padded Heavy-Duty Dog Collar
summary: A thick nylon collar with a padded lining for strong, active dogs.
description:
A tough nylon collar made for bigger, active dogs. The padded lining is comfortable against the neck, and the strong buckle and ring are built for daily walks.

Several colours and sizes are available. Measure your dog's neck before choosing.

title: Fold-Away Wall Drying Rack
summary: A slim aluminium rack that folds flat against the wall when you're not drying clothes.
description:
A space-saving drying rack for small homes, balconies and utility rooms. Fold it out to hang clothes, then fold it flat against the wall when you're done.

It's made from aluminium and comes in several widths.

title: Sculptural Body Vase
summary: A ceramic vase shaped like a figure, in white or gold, for flowers or display.
description:
A striking ceramic vase in the shape of a figure, adding an artistic touch to a shelf, mantelpiece or table.

Choose white or gold in two sizes. Flowers aren't included.

title: Soft Bath & Door Mat
summary: A soft, absorbent mat for the bathroom, kitchen or front door, in several sizes.
description:
A soft, plush mat that's comfy underfoot after a shower and absorbs drips. It also works well by the front door or the kitchen sink.

Choose your colour and size, from small mats to long runners.

title: Outdoor Utility Dog Vest
summary: A rugged harness-vest with pockets and handles for active dogs and long walks.
description:
A rugged vest for bigger dogs who love long walks and adventures. It has a top handle and attachment points, plus space to clip on small items.

Available in several colours and sizes. Sizes run small, so measure your dog and check the size guide.
bullets: Sizes run small: check the guide

title: Cat Paw Glass Mug
summary: A frosted glass mug with a cute paw shape inside, for coffee, milk or tea.
description:
A fun glass mug with a little paw design moulded inside, which shows up when it's filled with coffee or milk.

It makes a great gift for cat and dog lovers. Choose from several designs.
bullets: A great gift for pet lovers

title: Textured Porcelain Vase
summary: An unglazed porcelain vase with a speckled, textured finish in soft colours.
description:
A modern vase with a lovely textured, speckled finish. The unglazed porcelain gives it a natural, handmade look.

It comes in soft neutral and pastel colours and two sizes.

title: Push-Button Pet Slicker Brush
summary: A grooming brush with fine pins that releases the fur at the push of a button.
description:
Fine pins pick up loose fur and tangles as you brush. When the brush is full, push the button and the fur slides off, ready for the bin.

It suits dogs and cats, and multipacks are available.

title: Collapsible Silicone Lunch Box
summary: A silicone lunch box or cup that folds flat when empty, for work, school and picnics.
description:
Carry lunch out and bring the box home folded flat. This silicone container squashes down when it's empty, so it takes up less space in your bag.

Choose a lunch box or a drinks cup in grey, blue or pink.

title: Handheld Citrus Squeezer
summary: A compact manual juicer for squeezing lemons, limes and oranges straight into a glass.
description:
Fresh citrus juice without a machine. Cut the fruit, place it in the squeezer and press; the juice runs through while the pips stay behind.

It's small enough for any drawer and handy for drinks, dressings and baking.

reject: Mains 'power saver' device with unproven claims
Electrotherapy beauty device with medical claims
Chemical car wax - needs hazard labelling

title: Raised Cat Feeder with Clear Bowl
summary: An elevated stand with a tilted clear bowl, bringing food up to a comfortable height for cats.
description:
A raised feeder lifts the bowl off the floor so your cat doesn't need to crouch so low at mealtimes. The bowl is clear and slightly tilted, so food is easy to see and reach.

Choose a single or double bowl version in white or pink.
bullets: Raised stand for a comfortable height

title: Large Outdoor Tactical Backpack
summary: A rugged, many-pocket backpack for hiking, travel and day-to-day carry.
description:
A tough backpack built for the outdoors. It has a large main compartment and lots of extra pockets, so you can keep kit, snacks, a water bottle and a laptop organised.

The heavy-duty fabric copes with rain and rough handling, and it comes in black, khaki and camouflage styles.

title: Self-Threading Sewing Needles
summary: Needles with a slotted top: press the thread in instead of threading the eye.
description:
Quick fixes without the squinting. These needles have a slot at the top, so you just press the thread down into it instead of trying to push it through a tiny eye.

They're handy for buttons, hems and quick repairs, and come in single or multipacks.
bullets: Press the thread in: no threading

title: Ceramic Tilted Bowl with Wooden Stand
summary: A tilted ceramic pet bowl on a wooden stand, for an easier, tidier mealtime.
description:
A smart pet feeder with a ceramic bowl set at an angle on a wooden stand. The tilt makes food easier to reach, and the raised height is comfortable for cats and small dogs.

Choose blue, white or pink, or a double set.

title: 5-Level Resistance Band Set
summary: Loop bands in five strengths for legs, glutes, stretching and Pilates.
description:
Short loop bands are great for leg, hip and glute exercises, as well as warm-ups and stretching. Each colour is a different strength, so you can progress as you get stronger.

Buy single bands or the full set with a storage bag.
bullets: Singles or a full set with bag

title: Rocker Garlic Press
summary: A curved stainless steel press: rock it over garlic or ginger to crush it in seconds.
description:
A simpler kind of garlic press. Place it over a peeled clove and rock it back and forth; the garlic is pressed through the holes and the press is easy to rinse clean.

It works on ginger too. Choose stainless steel or black, singly or in multipacks.
bullets: Rock to crush garlic or ginger

title: Double-Handle Reflective Dog Lead
summary: A lead with a second handle near the clip, for close control when you need it.
description:
This lead has two handles: one at the end for relaxed walking, and one near the clip for close control at road crossings or busy paths.

Reflective strips help on darker walks, and a metal ring lets you clip on poo bags or a travel bowl.
bullets: Two handles for long or close control

title: Garden Golf Practice Net
summary: A pop-up practice net for hitting golf balls in the garden or park.
description:
Practise your swing at home. This net sets up in the garden or a local park and catches your shots, so you can work on your game between rounds.

Options include practice balls, a hitting mat and different sizes. Check you have enough clear space around you before swinging.

title: Magnetic Wooden Utensil Holder
summary: A freestanding wooden board with hidden magnets that holds metal kitchen tools on display.
description:
Keep your metal kitchen tools tidy and easy to grab. This freestanding wooden board has magnets hidden inside, so steel utensils cling to either side.

It saves drawer space and looks good on the worktop. Wipe it clean with a dry cloth.

title: Fold-Out Phone Stand Stick-On
summary: A slim metal stand that sticks to the back of your phone and folds out for hands-free viewing.
description:
A super-slim stand that sticks onto the back of your phone or case. Fold it out to prop your phone up for videos and video calls, then fold it flat again.

It works in portrait and landscape, and comes in several colours.
bullets: Sticks to the back of your phone or case
Folds flat when not in use

title: Semi-Covered Plush Cat Bed
summary: A cosy velvet bed with a half-hood for cats who like to tuck themselves away.
description:
A soft bed with a partial hood that gives cats a sheltered spot to curl up, without being fully enclosed.

The velvet and plush linings are warm and soft. Several colours are available.

title: Spaghetti Portion Measurer
summary: A handy gauge with holes for measuring dried spaghetti by the portion.
description:
No more cooking far too much pasta. Slide dried spaghetti into the hole for the number of portions you need and you've got the right amount.

It's flat and small enough to keep in a drawer or hang up.

title: Adjustable Nylon Pet Collar
summary: A simple, comfortable nylon collar with a quick-release buckle, for cats and dogs.
description:
An everyday collar that's easy to fit and adjust. The quick-release buckle makes it simple to put on and take off.

It comes in blue, black or red, in sizes from extra small to extra large.

title: Window Sill Cat Seat
summary: A sturdy perch that fixes to the window sill so your cat can lounge in the sun.
description:
Give your cat a sunny seat with a view. This perch attaches at the window and has a strong frame with a removable fabric cover.

The cover can be taken off for washing. Fit it carefully and check it regularly.
bullets: A sunny spot with a view

title: Soft Printed Pet Blanket
summary: A soft fleece blanket for beds, sofas and car seats, in fun prints.
description:
A soft, cosy blanket for your pet's favourite spot. Lay it in their bed, on the sofa or across the back seat to keep fur off.

It's machine washable and comes in fun prints and several sizes.

title: Pet Car Seat Belt Tether
summary: An adjustable tether that clips your pet's harness to the car's seat belt buckle.
description:
Keep your pet settled in one spot on car trips. One end clips into the seat belt buckle and the other to your pet's harness.

The length adjusts, and it's available in several colours and twin packs. Always use it with a harness.
bullets: Clips into the seat belt buckle

title: Padded Bike Seat
summary: A thick, cushioned replacement saddle for more comfortable rides.
description:
Make your rides more comfortable with a thicker, softer saddle. Silicone padding sits under a hard-wearing faux-leather cover.

It fits most standard seat posts, and comes in black with a choice of accent colours.

title: Waterproof Motorbike Cover
summary: A silver-coated cover that protects your motorbike or scooter from rain, dust and sun.
description:
Keep your bike cleaner and drier between rides. This cover slips over a motorbike or scooter and protects it from rain, dust, bird droppings and the sun.

Choose the size to fit your bike.
bullets: Protects from rain, dust and sun
